notes.title: Forg QoL Update! + New Level
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved tutorial & tutorial prompts for better clarity.
[*] Building limit now shows max text instead of cost.
[*] Increased music volume by +5 dB.
[*] Added more tips "IT'S OVER, GOBLINS. I HAVE THE HIGH GROUND!" - CANNON
[*] Moved loading screen tips to the options tab due to faster load times.
[*] [b]Replaced icons and symbols with emojis to fix alignment issues.[/b] 🪙❤️💥💣🌑☀️
[*] Made upgrade information easier to understand, add extra information as tips.
[*] [b]Collect gold from chests.[/b]
[*] [b]Eat mushrooms to heal.[/b]
[*] Corrected next item and previous item scroll order issues.
[*] Fixed scroll UI bugs.
[*] Resolved speed line overlay bugs and made improvements.
[*] Fixed damage overlay bugs and made improvements.
[*] Adjusted barricade model ropes.
[*] Added more shake effects for interactions.
[*] Achievements now available on more levels.
[*] Removed fruit basket.
[*] All levels baked.
[*] [b]New OG Level Crystal, Very Hard+ Start with 100 gold (instead of 400) & No healing mushrooms and limited high ground for strategic placements. Big respect to you if you can beat Crystal on Night Mode.[/b]
[*] Fix place building flash.
[*] Add bomb place particles.
[*] Fix sky resources.
[*] Updated screenshots.
[*] Update GIFs.
[*] Updated trailer.

[h2]Roadmap:[/h2]
[*] Engine upgrade for better performance.
[*] Community feedback and suggestions.
[/list]

notes.title: Forg Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Loading screen improvements
- Bullets interact with grass
- Enable v-sync by default
- Make default sens higher
- New bomb building
- Make barricades price / 2
- Bigger bomb goblin hit box
- Reduce wait time from 30sec > 15sec
- Variable jump heights
- Many new SFX
- BIG Color adjustments 
- Grass/ground changes 
- Saturation changes
- Smarter goblin navigation
- Cannon rotation bug fix
- Add back unstuck
- Game name change from "Forge Front" to "Forg" to make it easier to search for and more memorable.
- Balance worlds 
- Balance goblin economy
- Balance Furnace
- Update steam page
- Cannon rope model fix
- tutorial changes
- More credits
- Tree improvements
- Wind and water improvements
- Fix bug reset buildings placed for each level


[b]Roadmap:[/b]
- More SFX, music improvements 
- Balance
- Feedback and suggestions from the community

notes.title: Forge Front New Demo Available! + Roadmap
notes.content:
The new demo is here, and it’s packed with big changes and a ton of new content! We've added new goblin types, more levels, a hub area, upgraded graphics, and much more!

[b]ROADMAP[/b]
- More sound effects
- Game balancing
- Optimization improvements
- Feedback and suggestions from the community
- (Maybe) a new building

notes.title: Forge Front Demo Available!
notes.content: The demo is now available, and it features a tutorial level, but it's missing waves that will be added in a future build and then a rift to a fully functional level with 5 waves of goblins things we will add in the following months are more buildings more enemies and more levels and other smaller changes and improvements based on feedback, so please join the discord to give any feedback, thanks.
